overall: The AG found the complaint timely but, lacking sufficient evidence of a quorum deliberating outside a meeting, found no Open Meeting Law violation and declined to review the collusion and campaign-law claims.

allegations.summary: Board argued the complaint was untimely; the complaint alleged a quorum deliberated before the May 8 forum and was filed June 9.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed with the Board on Monday, June 9, it was timely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the five-member Select Board deliberated outside a posted meeting to arrange two members' speaking roles at the League's May 8 Candidates' Night.
allegations.key_passage: However, based upon our investigation, there is insufficient evidence to support a formal finding that the three members communicated, either directly or in a serial fashion, outside of a posted meeting regarding matters within the Board’s jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged collusion and campaign or election law violations by having Board members speak at the Candidates' Night.
allegations.key_passage: These allegations fall outside the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
